capability.summary: Return recursive Git submodule status as unparsed command-line text
capability.description: Runs `git -C <repo> submodule status --recursive` for one required existing repository and captures its stdout. It reports nested submodule state text without initializing, updating, syncing, fetching, or modifying submodules.
capability.problem_space: Read-only recursive submodule status inspection for one Git repository; not submodule initialization, update, synchronization, cloning, removal, or structured dependency-health validation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing Git repository path; output: JSON process envelope with raw recursive `git submodule status` stdout, stderr, and exit code.
accepted_inputs: an existing local Git repository directory whose submodules should be listed recursively
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "git", target: string, exit_code: 0, result: null, stdout: string, stderr: string|null}; stdout contains Git's unparsed recursive submodule lines and may be empty when no submodules exist. Nonzero Git result uses the same keys with status="tool_error" and propagates Git's exit code. Non-existing path, missing executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "git", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: returns unparsed Git text with result=null; consumers must interpret leading space, `-`, `+`, or `U` status markers and commit/path text
always uses `--recursive` and exposes no pathspec, cached, summary, or other Git submodule options
does not initialize, update, sync, fetch, clone, deinitialize, or repair submodules and does not verify remote availability
requires Git on PATH, uses a fixed 120-second timeout, and captures output without truncation

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing raw recursive `git submodule status` text and process metadata; no submodule state is changed.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: list submodule commits and paths without updating them
negative_intents: initialize update sync fetch or clone Git submodules
return parsed submodule status objects or dependency health conclusions
inspect ordinary branches tags logs or working-tree diffs
